answer: A sybil cluster must fund separate deposits per identity and sustain genuine output, which we measure against a per-agent score floor, not the network nadir. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and maintain a public thread of attested work; peers verify the thread before granting tasks. Faking history costs a full deposit plus the compute to reach the score knoll where rewards begin, making mass identity creation economically irrational.
